canonicalReference.description: Use the supplied inline canonical red-dress character image as the visual identity authority. One original glamorous adult woman with warm honey-caramel brown skin, mature almond eyes, arched brows, angular simplified nose, soft red lips and the tiny beauty mark under the outer viewer-left eye in the canonical frontal image (same anatomical side at other angles). Preserve the dramatic deep chestnut/burgundy sculpted wave, curled forelock and long thick polished waves. Outfit is locked: fitted deep crimson midi dress, long sleeves, draped waist, pearl stud earrings, short pearl necklace, understated pearl bracelet and matching red pumps. No face, hairstyle, skin-tone or wardrobe substitutions.
